record.question: When departmental proceedings initiated for the imposition of a major penalty conclude with the imposition of a minor penalty, how should the period of suspension be treated, and how are the pay and allowances to be regulated?
options: The suspension can be said to be wholly unjustified and the Government servant should be paid full pay and allowances for the period of suspension.
The period of suspension period will be treated as such and subsistence allowance paid
The entire period of suspension period will be treated as duty and subsistence allowance paid
